title: Gradient descent rolls downhill
summary: On f(x) = x² − 4x + 5 from x = 0 with learning rate 0.25, each step moves against the slope; the path is computed from the objective.

entities.text: Find the x that makes f(x) = x² − 4x + 5 smallest

beats.title: A valley to find
beats.narration: We want the lowest point of this curve without solving for it — just by following the slope downhill.
